attributes.text:
A 4-bit CPU. Each press of STEP runs
one instruction: 2 opcode bits, 4 bits D.
  00 LDI d   ACC = d
  01 ADD d   ACC = ACC + d
  10 OUT     OUT = ACC
  11 JMP d   go to instruction d
The program counts down from 9:
  0 LDI 9   1 OUT   2 ADD 15   3 JMP 1
ADD 15 subtracts 1, because 4 bits
wrap around at 16.
